text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Here's a Pearl question for you. Who's
the biggest
lover of regional bento in
the world? That's right,
me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Second Pearl question! Who requested
the school
store to stock regional
bento? That's right, me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Last one! When the buyer insisted
"regional bento
should be eaten in their
home regions," who made
them see the
error of their ways? That's right, me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Eat the regional bento, know the region.
I showed
them a whole new world of
bento. Heh, our souls
came to an
understanding.
